components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action in a view or dialog.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Every other action, such as Done.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 38px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; font: 500 14px var(--font); white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms; background: var(--secondary); color: var(--text); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--secondary-hover); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: The standard field in dialogs and settings.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); font: 400 14px var(--font); transition: border-color 120ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--placeholder); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--accent); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Rail Tile
components.description: Rounded-square tiles on the rail, with the pill marking state.
components.css: .ds-rail { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; width: 72px; padding: 8px 0; background: var(--chrome); } .ds-rail-item { position: relative; display: flex; justify-content: center; } .ds-rail-pill { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 0; width: 4px; height: 0; border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0; background: var(--strong); transform: translateY(-50%); transition: height 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-rail-item.is-unread .ds-rail-pill { height: 8px; } .ds-rail-item:hover .ds-rail-pill { height: 20px; } .ds-rail-item.is-current .ds-rail-pill { height: 32px; } .ds-rail-tile { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--rail-tile); color: var(--strong); font: 600 14px var(--font); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms, color 120ms, border-radius 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-rail-tile:hover { border-radius: 10px; } .ds-rail-tile:hover, .ds-rail-tile[aria-current] { background: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent); } .ds-rail-tile:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Channel Row
components.description: Sidebar rows with default, hover, and current states.
components.css: .ds-channels { display: grid; gap: 2px; width: 248px; padding: 8px; background: var(--sidebar); } .ds-nav-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; height: 32px; padding: 0 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: none; color: var(--muted); font: 500 15px var(--font); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-row:hover { background: var(--hover); color: var(--text); } .ds-nav-row[aria-current='page'] { background: var(--selected); color: var(--strong); } .ds-nav-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Message
components.description: Flat, full-width message rows with a hover wash and no bubble.

Sam Rivera5:49 PM

components.css: .ds-message { position: relative; padding: 2px 48px 2px 72px; background: var(--bg); font-family: var(--font); line-height: 1.375; } .ds-message:hover { background: var(--message-hover); } .ds-message-avatar { position: absolute; top: 4px; left: 16px; display: flex; } .ds-message-meta { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; } .ds-message-meta strong { color: var(--strong); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-message-meta time { color: var(--faint); font-size: 12px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-message-body { margin: 0; color: var(--text); font-size: 16px; } .ds-mascot { position: relative; display: inline-grid; flex: none; width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fb923c; } .ds-mascot::before, .ds-mascot::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 37%; width: 9%; height: 26%; border-radius: 99px; background: white; } .ds-mascot::before { left: 35%; } .ds-mascot::after { right: 35%; }

components.css: .ds-composer { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; min-height: 52px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--input); transition: box-shadow 120ms; } .ds-composer:focus-within { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--line-strong); } .ds-composer textarea { flex: 1; min-width: 0; min-height: 52px; padding: 15px 16px; border: 0; outline: 0; resize: none; background: none; color: var(--text); font: 400 16px/22px var(--font); } .ds-composer textarea::placeholder { color: var(--placeholder); } .ds-composer button { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; margin: 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: none; color: var(--accent); cursor: pointer; } .ds-composer button:hover { background: var(--hover); } .ds-composer button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-account { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 304px; height: 56px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--panel); font-family: var(--font); } .ds-account-avatar { position: relative; display: flex; } .ds-account-avatar .ds-mascot { width: 32px; height: 32px; } .ds-presence { position: absolute; right: -2px; bottom: -2px; width: 12px; height: 12px; border: 2px solid var(--panel); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--green); } .ds-account-name { display: grid; flex: 1; min-width: 0; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-account-name strong { color: var(--strong); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-account-name span { color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; } .ds-icon-button { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: none; color: var(--muted); cursor: pointer; } .ds-icon-button:hover { background: var(--hover); color: var(--text); } .ds-icon-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-mascot { position: relative; display: inline-grid; flex: none; width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fb923c; } .ds-mascot::before, .ds-mascot::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 37%; width: 9%; height: 26%; border-radius: 99px; background: white; } .ds-mascot::before { left: 35%; } .ds-mascot::after { right: 35%; }

components.css: .ds-access { padding: 40px 16px; background: var(--access-field); font-family: var(--font); } .ds-access-card { width: min(480px, 100%); margin: auto; padding: 32px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--access-card); box-shadow: var(--shadow-card); } .ds-access-card h1 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--strong); font-size: 24px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.25; text-align: center; } .ds-access-card label { display: grid; gap: 8px; margin-top: 16px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-access-card input { width: 100%; height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--access-input); color: var(--text); font: 400 16px var(--font); } .ds-access-card input:focus { border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--accent); } .ds-access-card input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-access-card button { width: 100%; height: 44px; margin-top: 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent); font: 500 16px var(--font); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms; } .ds-access-card button:hover { background: var(--accent-hover); } .ds-access-card button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
A Discord user should know where everything is at first sight. Huddle deliberately follows Discord's desktop shell, at the user's request, and plays it straight: a rail of rounded-square tiles, a channel sidebar, a flexible chat, a member list, a composer at the bottom, and an account panel floating across the rail and sidebar. Recognition is the design. Nothing here competes with that layout for attention, and the shell asks nothing of the people chatting in it.

Huddle keeps its own name and logo and uses no Discord logo, art, or font. The typeface is Figtree, bundled through `@fontsource-variable/figtree`. The result is a dense, flat, near-black room: a graphite shell around a slightly lifted chat ground, one indigo accent, and full-width messages with no bubbles. It replaces Huddle's earlier quiet SaaS arrangement of breadcrumbs, bubbles, and a centered message column.

The interface shows only what exists. Controls for unbuilt features (voice calls, search, emoji, attachments, presence) are deliberately absent, so a familiar layout never promises something the server cannot do. Voice channels are the one exception: they can be created and listed, and opening one says voice isn't available yet, with no call controls. The theme follows the system. Dark values were sampled from Mobbin captures of Discord; the light palette is derived, with no reference.
keyCharacteristics: A fixed floor plan that a Discord user reads without learning it.
Flat, full-width messages on a slightly lifted ground inside a darker shell.
One indigo accent for action, focus, and the current place on the rail.
Hairlines and tonal steps for structure; shadows only where something floats.
Figtree throughout, with a tight type ramp and a 14px interface base.

rules.name: The Sampled Ground Rule
rules.body: Dark values were sampled from Mobbin captures of Discord. The light palette is derived, with no reference, so check a light value by contrast and by capture rather than by comparison to a source.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Indigo marks action, focus, and the current place on the rail. It is never a panel ground, and no second accent exists.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Figtree sets everything people read as language. Monospace appears only for machine values such as hostnames and invite codes.

rules.name: The Quiet Label Rule
rules.body: Shell labels stay 12px and mixed case. Uppercase belongs to field and list labels inside the access card, and nowhere in the shell.

rules.name: The Flat Shell Rule
rules.body: Rail, sidebar, chat, member list, and account panel carry no shadow. A shadow means the element is temporarily above the shell or sits on the access field.

dos: Do place every shell zone where a Discord user expects it: 72px rail, 248px sidebar, flexible chat, 240px member list, composer at the bottom, account panel floating across rail and sidebar.
Do keep the Huddle name and logo on the rail and access screens.
Do set messages flat and full width, with authors grouped and continuation lines flush.
Do use the Rail Pill lengths exactly: 8px unread, 20px hover or focus, 32px current.
Do read every color from the tokens in `src/chat.css` so both modes resolve, and define a new role in both.
Do use Lucide line icons, mostly at 16 to 20px, in `muted`, moving to `text` or `strong` with state.
Do build separation from hairlines and tonal steps before reaching for a shadow.
Do draw the merged 32px window bar over every desktop screen, with traffic lights on macOS and drawn controls elsewhere.
donts: Don't use Discord's logo, illustrations, or proprietary font.
Don't add controls for features that are not built, including voice calls, search, emoji, attachments, and presence.
Don't show a presence dot anywhere but the account panel, or use it for anything but connection state.
Don't put messages in bubbles or constrain the thread to a centered column. Home, setup, and settings may still use a readable column.
Don't add breadcrumbs to the top bar.
Don't uppercase labels in the shell.
Don't add a resting shadow to the rail, sidebar, chat, member list, or account panel.
Don't use a gradient outside the access field.
